title: Stir-fried Savoy Cabbage
description: Quick stir-fried Savoy cabbage with chilli, garlic and ginger in a soy-rice vinegar glaze, finished with toasted sesame seeds.

ingredients.text: 1 small red chilli, deseeded and finely chopped
2cm (¾in) piece of root ginger, peeled and finely grated
a pinch of granulated sweetener or caster sugar
sea salt and freshly ground black pepper
Preheat the grill on a medium setting.

steps: Put the sesame seeds in a small ovenproof dish and place under the hot grill to toast for 3–4 minutes until golden, taking care to watch them carefully as they can burn easily.
Spray a large frying pan or wok with some low-calorie cooking spray and place over a medium heat.
Add the chilli, garlic and ginger and fry for 1–2 minutes, until just turning lightly golden.

Increase the heat to high and add the cabbage, rice wine vinegar, soy sauce and sweetener or sugar, and stir-fry for 3–4 minutes, stirring constantly. Be careful not to overcook the cabbage – it should still retain some crispness and its bright colour.
Season to taste with salt and pepper and serve at once, sprinkled with the toasted sesame seeds.
